# Breach & Trace

> Documentary investigations into real scam and cybercrime cases — FBI alerts, Justice Department releases and court records — and exactly what to do so it never happens to you or your parents.

Documentary investigations of real scam and cybercrime cases, built on FBI/IC3 alerts, U.S. Justice Department releases and court records. Each case page has a short answer, Q&A, primary sources and the full transcript of the video. Videos: https://www.youtube.com/@BreachAndTrace
Languages: en, de, fr, es, ru, zh-Hans, ja, ar (e.g. https://alphaaisender-cloud.github.io/de/, https://alphaaisender-cloud.github.io/es/).

That exact script took more than 30 women, mostly older, for over $3.5 million. One man got 25 years in federal prison.
